source_facts.fact: GET_PET_STYLE_FORM_ITEM=1893; request item_id; success callback consumes active_style and pet_styles then removes exactly one local backpack item.
USE_PET_STYLE=1894; request pet_id+style_id; success consumes active_style.
CANCEL_PET_STYLE=1895; request pet_id; success body state is unused and client sets active_style=0 locally.
Current and v1.164 Pet UI expose CANCEL whenever any home style is active; another USE is not reachable until cancel.
Backpack can issue MID1893 for a qualified unowned style without consulting current active_style.
Pet.petStyles and activeStyle store style item IDs; ItemTable.stylePet maps style item to canonical Pet family; SelfPlayer.getPetIgnoreAwaken resolves base/awakened collected instance.
Current and v1.164 item descriptions characterize the consumables as obtaining/getting the Pet cabin, corroborating acquisition distinct from selection.

differential_findings: Current and v1.164 callers/state model agree on MID1893/1894/1895 shapes and cancel-before-switch reachability.
Frozen V1 protocol registry corroborates MID identities but supplies no original-server semantic implementation; it remains differential/corroborative only.
APK/smali search supplied no discriminating native semantic evidence for Pet home-style mutations.
candidate_translation_requirements: MID1893 acquisition must be grant-only and preserve pre-operation effective active style; it may normalize a stale raw selector but must not auto-select the acquired style.
MID1893 first acquisition must debit exactly one qualified style item through I5 only after canonical Pet owner lock and persist entitlement+normalized/preserved active_style with one Pet CAS.
MID1894 selects only effectively owned, family-qualified style and rejects different-style direct switch while another effective style is active.
MID1895 assigns desired active_style=0 and may normalize a stale raw positive selector.
Stock outputs remain exact: 1893 active_style+pet_styles; 1894 active_style; 1895 empty object; no invented inventory/economy/time fields.
Historical Pet MID60/MID61 ordinary-skin path stays inactive; CA7-6+ routes remain fenced.
Same-operation D11 flow must include pre-transaction replay, early in-transaction recheck before content-dependent owner discovery, and post-Pet-lock recheck.

Fresh already-owned MID1893 must not debit again even though a stale second client may locally remove one item after its success callback; this is a bounded client-cache residual, not permission to invent response fields.
epistemic_note: Source facts constrain wire/reachability/identity. Grant-only, stale-selector normalization, D11 schemas and HTTP status distinctions are V2 compatibility/implementation decisions constrained by accepted CA7 authority, not claims about unrecovered original-server internals.
